videos.script: This is the first of six short lessons, one per family of models. Each reads the provider's own page, dated, and puts it next to the sheet. {{lineup}} Anthropic sells four tiers: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus and Fable. Each step up costs about twice the one below. {{dates}} Every model carries two dates. When its knowledge stops, and the earliest it may be retired. On the day this was recorded, Haiku's was eight days away. {{platforms}} The same model is sold by the clouds too, under five different names. Keep the name in configuration, not in code. {{features}} Last, what is particular to Claude. Thinking and effort, which change cost and speed. And a cache that is cheap to read, with a minimum size that differs by model.
